Integrity and semantic validation precede exposure. M18.73-76 are explicitly intermediate delivery boundaries; M18.14 remains open for full offline three-of-5000 equivalence and migration/gate integration. assessment.standardsDrift: ADRs 0182-0185 accompany the contract additions, schema/API reports, fixtures and changesets. Format directly uses the existing catalog Zod version with recorded rationale. Real Zod is intentionally retained in both standalone host builds for untrusted data; routing retains its former stub under the amended ADR-0026. E2E stabilization adds settled-geometry/final-source assertions without widening visual tolerance or adding retries. No abandoned convention found in the reviewed delta.
assessment.gateHonesty: The supplied exact-HEAD packet reports 28/71, correctly red on missing features, current-revision mutation/CI evidence and final review. M18.71 resolves cp5 F1 by binding real artwork and legacy browser suites and SDK loader node suite. Independently executed harness probes reject absent suites, empty/skipped/failing assertions, missing/malformed reports and nonzero runner exits. The portable end-to-end leg remains red while M18.14 is open. Three source-level mutant spot-checks below constrain meaningful behavior; they were imagined, not executed mutants.
assessment.architecture: Core and format remain pure, with injected hashing and explicit content policy. Loader validation does not mutate registries. Host registration preflights every subset and namespace conflict and rolls back inserted definitions on refusal. Portable saving snapshots document and bytes before asynchronous hashing. Public API expansion is purposeful (subset/source/lock/result types, portable writer APIs and shared registration), documented and covered by API reports; no new dependency version or executable pack activation found.
